jobDescription:
Data Analyst - FinEdge Analytics

About the role
We are hiring a Data Analyst to own reporting and experimentation for our lending products. You will work with product, risk and finance teams to turn raw data into decisions.

What you will do
- Build and maintain dashboards in Power BI and Tableau for executive and operational reporting
- Write complex SQL against PostgreSQL and Snowflake to model funnel, cohort and retention metrics
- Design and analyse A/B tests, run hypothesis testing and communicate results to non-technical stakeholders
- Automate recurring reports and data pipelines with Python (Pandas) and Airflow
- Perform data cleaning, data validation and exploratory data analysis on large datasets
- Partner with data engineers on ETL jobs and data warehouse modelling

What we are looking for
- 2+ years in a data analyst or business analyst role
- Advanced SQL, Python (Pandas, NumPy), Excel and data visualisation skills
- Experience with statistical analysis, regression and forecasting
- Familiarity with Snowflake or BigQuery, dbt, Git and version control
- Strong communication skills and stakeholder management
- Nice to have: experience with credit risk, Looker, Mixpanel, machine learning basics
